scripts.dev: node scripts/ensure-infra.mjs && turbo run dev worker:dev rollup-consumer:dev export-worker:dev --concurrency=20
scripts.dev:local: cross-env DISABLE_KAFKA=true DISABLE_REDIS=true DISABLE_S3=true turbo run dev
scripts.dev:services: cross-env DISABLE_KAFKA=true DISABLE_REDIS=true DISABLE_S3=true turbo run dev --filter=gateway --filter=identity-svc --filter=catalog-svc --filter=assessment-svc --filter=analytics-svc --filter=notification-svc
scripts.dev:infra: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres redis redpanda redpanda-console minio
scripts.dev:infra:down: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml stop postgres redis redpanda redpanda-console minio
scripts.db:seed:local: pnpm --filter identity-svc db:seed && pnpm --filter catalog-svc db:seed
